The Alexandria DOT Paratransit app lets you pre-book rides quickly and easily. You can track your vehicle as it arrives or simply wait for the “I’m here” notification from your driver. 

Change your mind about a trip? Cancel a trip just as easily as you booked it directly from the app.

It’s a shared service where you may be traveling with other passengers along the way.
